description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git fast-import' functionality with signed tags in different cryptographic formats (OpenPGP, X.509, SSH). It sets up various test cases to verify behavior when importing signed tags with different signatures and configurations.

methods.name: git fast-import
methods.description: Imports data into the git repository, supporting signed tags.
